papers.title_en: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Warehouse Logistics Automation Optimization
papers.authors: Md Mahinur Alam, Kanita Jerin Tanha, Md Tanjin Alam, Shadman Sakib, Min Gyu Kim
papers.evidence: 强化学习与数字孪生用于仓储物流优化
papers.tldr: 针对仓储物流中静态货位策略难以适应实时变化的问题，提出一种融合强化学习与数字孪生的动态货位优化框架。该方法在基于FlexSim的四区域仓库孪生环境中训练智能体，并借助资产管理壳实现学习体、物理资产与孪生体交互。实验显示平均拣选时间降低29.66%、吞吐量提升35.42%、行走距离减少18.54%。结果表明数据驱动的实时货位优化可显著提升仓储自动化效率。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, warehouse logistics optimization has increasingly focused on intelligent, data-driven systems to enhance operational efficiency. Conventional static product placement strategies are being progressively replaced by dynamic slotting approaches that can adapt to real-time variations in warehouse conditions. In this work, we present a novel framework that employs a reinforcement learning agent integrated within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment for real-time product placement optimization. The proposed agent continuously learns from streaming operational data, enabling it to reduce picking time while improving overall system throughput. The simulation environment models a four-zone warehouse layout with forklift-based material handling and leverages the Asset Administration Shell framework to ensure seamless interaction between the learning agent, physical asset, and the digital twin. Experimental evaluation demonstrates substantial performance gains, with the proposed approach achieving a 29.66\% reduction in average picking time, a 35.42\% increase in throughput, and an 18.54\% decrease in travel distance.

papers.title_en: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
papers.evidence: 融合知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体大模型层的三引擎架构
papers.tldr: 金融AI需处理支付、催收、现金流与合规等决策问题，LLM难以独立保证数值准确、可追溯与可审计。论文提出三引擎架构：金融知识图谱提供关系与时效溯源，确定性优化引擎负责计算决策，多智能体LLM层做意图理解、编排、解释与声明校验，并以上下文工程协调跨ERP与租户上下文。15个部署约11个月观察显示，单智能体幻觉率约7-9%，图支撑多智能体验证后降至1%以下；复用映射与验证策略使部署从约六周缩至两周。
papers.abstract_en: Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants.   Based on observations from 15 deployments over approximately 11 months, single-agent pipelines exhibited hallucination rates of about 7-9% (5-10% across query types), including invented invoices and unsupported financial claims. Graph-backed multi-agent validation reduced observed rates to below 1%, although these findings are observational rather than causal. ERP data quality and tenant-specific schemas remained major implementation challenges. Reusable mappings, graph templates, and validation policies coincided with a reduction in deployment time from roughly six to two weeks.   We argue that financial context engineering extends beyond text-centric retrieval-augmented generation by requiring structured relationships, temporal validity, exact numerical evidence, access controls, and validation against source records and solver outputs. We outline research challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, privacy, context quality, and cross-tenant generalization.

papers.title_en: The Generalised Kessler Syndrome and the Persian Gulf
papers.evidence: 将级联失效理论推广到供应链，刻画故障传播与库存耗竭
papers.tldr: 本文将凯斯勒综合征从轨道碎片级联推广到供应链：故障经加性通道扩散，修复能力经减性通道被侵蚀，损伤超过修复便不可逆。以库存为连接，海湾国家自2026年春海运受限，空运与陆运补偿不足，库存不均耗尽并拖累物流系统。吞吐优化加剧脆弱性，霍尔木兹海峡限制是触发器；用凯利组合与最弱环节收益建模，最优策略应集中资源于滞后投入而非领先投入。
papers.abstract_en: The term Kessler syndrome was coined for a runaway orbital cascade creating a high-density debris field. The idea is generalised and applied to supply chains. An additive channel enables failures to generate further failures; a subtractive channel erodes the capacity to contain and restore. When damage outpaces repair, failure becomes irreversible and the system settles into a new state. Supplies connect the theory to its application. Stocks insulate subsystems from one another, and their exhaustion exposes dependencies. For the Persian Gulf states, restrictions on maritime supplies from spring 2026 are inadequately compensated by air and road transport alternatives. This depletes inventories unevenly across products and impairs the functioning of the logistics system itself. Throughput optimisation builds fragility everywhere; the Gulf is where it is becoming visible, with the Strait of Hormuz restriction as the trigger. Formulated as a Kelly portfolio allocation under a weakest-link payoff, the optimal strategy concentrates resources on the lagging rather than the leading inputs.

papers.title_en: Graph-dependent pooling: adaptive granularity in hierarchical graph neural networks
papers.evidence: 层次化图神经网络池化方法
papers.tldr: 层次图池化通过逐层粗化图学习多级表示，但现有方法依赖预设簇数或固定池化比例，难以适应不同图结构。GDPool利用自注意力为每张图选择结构关键锚点，并通过软节点分配动态确定池化粒度，构建粗化图。在金属有机框架和分子图基准上，其预测性能全面领先，模块度更高且有效簇数随深度单调下降。该工作揭示了逐层目标间的梯度冲突，并实现图自适应层次池化。
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks are widely used to learn structural representations of relational data. Hierarchical graph pooling learns multi-level representations by progressively coarsening graphs; however, prior methods rely on predefined cluster numbers or fixed pooling ratios, limiting adaptability to individual graphs. We propose Graph-Dependent Pooling (GDPool), which dynamically determines pooling granularity for each graph. We analyze optimization conflicts among layer-wise objectives through gradient alignment, showing that independently supervised pooling levels can send conflicting gradients to shared parameters. GDPool uses self-attention to select graph-specific anchors representing structurally important nodes and constructs coarse graphs through soft node assignment. Experiments on metal-organic framework and molecular graph benchmarks show that GDPool consistently achieves the best predictive performance across all benchmarks. Evaluations using modularity and the effective number of clusters show that GDPool achieves consistently higher modularity than existing methods while the number of active clusters decreases monotonically with depth. Sensitivity analyses confirm stable behavior across hyperparameter and architectural choices.

papers.title_en: A Diagnostic Protocol for GNNs in Electricity Load Forecasting: Separating Parameter Sharing from Neighborhood Access
papers.authors: Eloi Campagne, Yvenn Amara-Ouali, Yannig Goude, Itai Zehavi, Argyris Kalogeratos
papers.evidence: 面向GNN预测模型的诊断协议
papers.tldr: 电力负荷预测中，GNN的增益可能来自跨序列参数共享，也可能来自邻接信息读取，二者若不拆分会误导是否维护图结构。本文提出诊断协议，将GNN与逐节点网络、无邻居共享网络及去边GNN对比，并用保度重连检验邻居身份。在法国区域负荷和英国低压馈线上，参数共享解释了大部分误差差距，边带来的增益较小且重连后多消失。因此，只有与逐节点和共享基线比较后，才应把预测增益归因于图。
papers.abstract_en: A graph neural network (GNN) forecasting a collection of load series combines two mechanisms, sharing parameters across series and reading neighboring series, and a gain over a non-graph model may come from either; telling them apart decides whether a graph is worth maintaining. We propose a model diagnostic protocol that compares the GNN with three reference models: a per-node network, a network shared across nodes without neighbors, and the same GNN without edges. Degree-preserving rewiring tests whether neighbor identity matters. After a tuned benchmark on regional load in France and on low-voltage feeders in the UK, we apply the protocol to deliberately short node histories, as when non-stationary demand leaves only recent observations relevant: the feeders, within one week, and a public dataset of client consumption series. On the feeders, sharing parameters recovers most of the error gap between node-specific models and GNNs, about two thirds against a regularized one. Adding the edges to an otherwise identical backbone brings a smaller gain, half or more of which disappears under rewiring. On the client series, the neighbor mean degrades the per-node model on the shorter window and the edges' gain is not consistently distinguishable from zero; on the regions of France, where each node's own history is already informative, the ranking between per-node models and GNNs changes with tuning. A synthetic study points to noisy local measurements as one regime where neighbors help. In an exploratory online aggregation, graph and non-graph forecasters appear complementary, and the weight assigned to GNNs is not proportional to their contribution. In none of the three datasets do the edges account for most of a GNN's advantage over node-specific models, so a forecasting gain should be credited to the graph only after comparison with per-node and shared references.

papers.title_en: Supply Chain Information Sharing among Competitors: Profit-Based Participation under Market Shocks
papers.authors: Batuhan Celik, Bahar Cavdar, Jennifer Pazour
papers.evidence: 市场冲击下的供应链信息共享协调
papers.tldr: 针对市场冲击下竞争者是否加入供应链信息共享平台的问题，本文将参与决策与产量决策建模为不完全信息两阶段动态博弈，并求解两家横向竞争者的闭式均衡参与策略。研究发现信息能力与生产效率共同塑造参与激励，信息不对称程度决定均衡平台构成。成本低效企业可能因共享信息被对手利用而回避，但为避免信息劣势也可能加入；不确定性可成为低效企业的竞争屏障，为信息共享平台机制设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Sharing information can help coordinate supply chain decisions in response to market shocks. Yet, firms must weigh these benefits against the risk of strengthening competitors. We study when competing firms voluntarily join an information-sharing platform to exchange information about market shocks while retaining operational autonomy. Firms differ in information capabilities and decide whether to participate before private signals are realized, creating stochastic information asymmetry. We model participation and quantity decisions as a two-stage dynamic game with incomplete information. For two horizontal competitors, we derive closed-form equilibrium participation strategies that reveal how information power and production efficiency shape participation. Numerical analysis examines more complex supply chain networks. We find that supply chain characteristics impact participation and the level of information asymmetry is a key factor in the equilibrium platform profiles. Firms with similar information power may benefit from joining forces to reduce their competitive disadvantage against higher information power competitors. Cost-inefficient firms may be less willing to participate because their competitors can exploit shared information, and uncertainty can serve as a competitive shield by restricting the actions of more efficient competitors. However, when several competitors join the platform, a cost-inefficient firm may also choose to participate to avoid an informational disadvantage.

papers.title_en: Multiple Leak Localization in Water Distribution Networks through Graph Neural Networks
papers.authors: Arvin Ajoodani, Sara Nazif, Pouria Ramazi
papers.evidence: 基于网络拓扑的图神经网络多故障定位
papers.tldr: 供水管网中多个漏点同时发生且监测稀疏时，漏损定位十分困难，现有数据驱动方法通常预设漏点数量或穷举漏点组合。本文提出一种图神经网络模型，无需预先指定漏点数量，也无需为训练穷举所有漏点位置组合，即可定位数量可变的多个同时漏点。在31节点Hanoi与92节点NET3两个基准网络上，该模型在变需求、稀疏压力监测、变漏损量级和多漏点场景下均优于MLP、SVM、KNN和随机森林，最高精度提升分别为12%和20%。
papers.abstract_en: Leak localization in water distribution networks is challenging when multiple leaks occur simultaneously, particularly under sparse monitoring. Existing data-driven methods often assume a single or predefined number of leaks or require extensive enumeration of leak combinations. This study proposes a graph neural network (GNN) model that localizes a variable number of simultaneous leaks without specifying the leak count in advance or exhaustively generating every possible combination of leak locations for training. The model is evaluated on two benchmark networks of different sizes, the 31-node Hanoi network and the larger 92-node NET3 network, under variable demand, sparse pressure-sensor coverage, variable leak magnitudes, and varying numbers of simultaneous leaks. The GNN outperforms multilayer perceptron, support vector machine, K-nearest neighbors, and random forest classifiers by up to 12% and 20% in accuracy respectively in Hanoi and NET3 networks. Consistent performance across both networks supports the scalability of the proposed approach.

papers.title_en: Conformal Predictive Distributions for Contextual Order Fulfillment Optimization
papers.authors: Tinghan Ye, Amira Hijazi, Pascal Van Hentenryck
papers.evidence: 面向订单履约的上下文优化与不确定性决策
papers.tldr: 电商到家履约需在下单时选仓与承运商，静态时效估计难以刻画订单与选项间的不确定性。本文用CPS回归和CVAP分类构建共形预测分布，并嵌入上下文优化，以C-SAA求解履约决策。在逾500万订单上，CVAP将准确日达率由49.5%升至64.1%；仿真中总成本降7.1%或6.7%，延迟率由5.7%降至4%以下。该框架为不确定履约提供可校准决策依据。
papers.abstract_en: Ship-to-home fulfillment requires a retailer to select a fulfillment location and carrier before the delivery time is known. These decisions often rely on static transit-time estimates, which cannot represent how delivery-time uncertainty varies across orders and fulfillment options. This paper constructs conformal predictive distributions (CPDs) using Conformal Predictive Systems (CPS) for regression and the cross Venn-Abers predictor (CVAP) for multiclass classification, and uses them in a contextual optimization model for fulfillment decisions. The model is solved by contextual sample-average approximation (C-SAA). The regret of each fulfillment decision, its expected cost above that of the best decision, is bounded by forecast error, scenario-evaluation error, and the candidate-generation gap. The forecast term depends on how well calibration residuals or class probabilities represent the current order. On more than five million proprietary order records, CVAP raises exact-day accuracy from 49.5% for the rule-based estimate to 64.1%. Paired with a decision rule that selects a quantile weighting late errors more heavily, the split CPS (SCPS) gives a point estimate that raises late-delivery detection from 3.8% to 79.4%. Residual-based CPS distributions also meet or slightly exceed nominal interval-coverage targets. In decision experiments with a JD.com simulator over six test dates, C-SAA with CVAP lowers mean total cost by 7.1% and C-SAA with the Mondrian CPS (MCPS) lowers it by 6.7%, relative to C-SAA with the original nonconformal forecast. Both cut the late-delivery rate from 5.7% to below 4.0%.

papers.title_en: Vendster: An Evaluation Arena to Investigate How Forecasting Tool Quality Affects LLM Agent Behaviors in Buyer-Vendor Negotiation
papers.evidence: 大语言模型智能体利用预测工具进行买方-供应商谈判
papers.tldr: 时序预测器多以精度排名，却很少衡量其对下游决策的价值，而LLM智能体正日益把预测器当作工具。作者构建Vendster评测场，让两个LLM智能体进行买方—卖方折扣谈判，检验预测偏差与区间宽度如何改变结果。在Vendster-M5上，模型预测使销售目标达成率最高提升17个百分点，但relWQL、MASE等精度指标无法显著预测谈判结果；受控实验显示低估偏差显著改善高反应性智能体的表现。研究说明预测偏差方向与智能体反应性比精度更关键，并开源了可定制评测环境。
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasters are ranked almost entirely by accuracy metrics, but a forecast's decision value, its effect on the downstream decision, need not track accuracy and is rarely measured. This problem compounds as large language model (LLM) agents increasingly consume forecasters as tools, mediating them through stochastic, opaque policies. We present Vendster, an evaluation arena measuring how a forecaster's bias and prediction-interval width change the outcome of a buyer--vendor discount negotiation between two LLM agents. In the reference instance Vendster-M5, sampling base demand patterns from the M5 dataset, we evaluate two frontier-closed LLM families (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Sol) and two open ones (DeepSeek-V3.2 and Qwen3-235B-A22B). Model-generated forecasts raise sales target attainment by up to +17 percentage points (p<0.001), yet standard forecast evaluation metrics such as relWQL and MASE do not predict negotiation outcomes at a statistically significant level. To isolate the causal structure, we substitute in synthetic forecasts with controlled bias and interval width. Under-prediction bias significantly improves outcomes for agents that react more to the forecasts---dose-response slopes -0.387 and -0.416 (p<0.001). Interval width has no statistically significant effect at zero bias. These findings indicate that the direction of forecast bias and agent forecast-reactivity are more strongly associated with downstream outcomes than forecast accuracy. Vendster is fully customizable and released under CC BY-NC 4.0 at https://github.com/amazon-science/Vendster.

papers.authors: Chan-Eui Song, Jeremy J. Michalek, Christopher McComb
papers.evidence: 将LLM与数值求解器及仿真器结合用于优化重设计
papers.tldr: 工程重设计需适应材料价格或需求变化，但复杂模拟器与传统数值求解器缺乏工程知识，难以兼顾全局质量。本文提出LLM与优化求解器集成的重设计方法，在电动车电池包成本案例中比较三种LLM用法与四种黑盒求解器。结果显示，集成方法以少80%模拟评估达到基线可行设计发现，并将近优解运行占比提高三倍。最佳组合取决于需求变化结构，LLM模型规模收益随其搜索控制程度增加，显示LLM引导或替代数值求解器的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Engineering design frequently involves redesigning a prior solution to adapt to changes in context, such as material prices or system requirements. Redesign often leverages simulators too complex and/or computationally intensive for traditional numerical solvers, which lack engineering knowledge and context, to ensure global solution quality. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret semantic information, including engineering knowledge about the system and changes in context, to help guide search, and recent studies have shown that incorporating this knowledge into optimization can improve search performance. However, how best to combine LLMs with numerical solvers in redesign remains unclear. We develop and test an integrated LLM-optimization approach for redesign and compare three methods for leveraging LLMs (warm start, variable fixing and ReAct) and four black-box solvers (Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search and random search) on an electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization case study across four types of redesign scenarios. We find that the integrated approach can match feasible design discovery of the numerical-solver baselines with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs that find near-optimal solutions. We find that the best LLM-solver integration approach and the way the prior solution is leveraged depend on the structure of the design requirement change, and that the benefit of increasing LLM model size grows with the extent to which the LLM controls the search. These results show clear potential for LLMs in redesign tasks for guiding or replacing numerical solvers.
